title: Team Chained Together
description: Chain your teams together for unique minigames!
body:
## Team Chained Together
This is a Minecraft plugin that uses the Chain and Lead plugins from Lodestone to chain teams of players together. Perfect for custom minigames and events, it creates new challenges and teamwork dynamics by linking players so they must move and act as a group. Requires Lead and Chain from Lodestone to work.

## Commands
- /chained start - Chains all team members together
- /chained stop - Unchains all players
- /chained setdistance - Allow you to increase chain max lenght
- /chained teamchain <team> - Chains players in target team
- /chained teamunchain <team> - Unchains players in target teams
